Late-game progression
🏛️ Archie Empire
This is the late-game system for players with ridiculous amounts of Archies. You do not have to reset anything just to use it.
1 · Spend ArchiesFund Mega Projects. The early projects eventually finish; the final projects can be upgraded forever.
2 · Build InfluenceProject levels and optional Vault sacrifices raise Empire Influence and your Empire rank.
3 · Ascend LaterAscension is optional. It restarts your normal economy for permanent Stars while keeping the major prestige systems.
0Influence
0Ascension Stars
0Ascensions
Local EntrepreneurNext rank
Mega Projects
Buying a stage permanently removes its price from your current Archie balance. It does not reduce Lifetime Archies. Project levels stay with you through Ascension.
What do projects give? Each funded level adds 1 Empire Influence. Influence mainly increases your Empire rank and gives a small capped production bonus. The main purpose is giving huge balances something worth spending on without another runaway x1000 multiplier.
Empire Vault
Optional money sink. Burn 10%, 25% or 50% of your current Archies for permanent Empire Influence. This does not touch Lifetime Archies, Legacy, cosmetics or Projects.
The bigger the sacrifice, the more Influence it can create. This permanently removes those current Archies.
✦ Archie Ascension
OPTIONAL — this is the only reset in the Empire section.
Ascension wipes current Archies, normal upgrade levels, one-time Boost purchases and current-run earnings. It keeps Lifetime Archies, Legacy Points/skills, cosmetics, friends, chests, Empire Influence, Empire Projects and previous Ascension Stars. In return you receive permanent Ascension Stars.
Reach 1Qi current Archies to Ascend.
Late-game destination
🌌 Archie Beyond · World 2
This is a second playable Archie world, not another normal era. It has its own currency, economy, upgrades, prestige loop and permanent progression — while World 1 keeps running in the background.
🔷 Beyond EssenceA completely separate World 2 currency and upgrade economy.
⚡ ResonanceActive clicking charges a meter and triggers Prime Overdrive.
✦ Prime AscensionPrestige World 2 for permanent Prime Cores.
🌠 ConstellationSpend Cores on permanent mastery nodes that survive Ascension.
Open the World 2 Portal
World 2 is deliberately expensive and intended for the strongest Archie Clicker players. Once unlocked, the portal stays open forever.
